chain.label: Low fuel annunciator lights easily overlooked
chain.trigger: these annunciator lights were easily overlooked, even when illuminated

chain.label: Crew failed to verify fuel loaded at FRG and monitor fuel state en route
chain.trigger: a lack of clear communication between the pilots and the fueler resulted in only 90 gallons (about 600 pounds) of fuel being added

caused_by.evidence: It was observed that the left seat pilot's right hand blocked a view of the lights when his right hand was on the control wheel

chain.label: Critically low fuel state by second approach to AVP
chain.trigger: the accident airplane departed FRG with about 1,600 pounds of fuel on board, which is 800 pounds less than listed on the load manifest

caused_by.evidence: the flight crewmembers failed to adequately monitor the airplane's fuel state en route and at ACY based on the expectation that they had sufficient fuel on board
the right engine stoppage could be explained by fuel exhaustion

chain.label: Course deviation and difficulty correcting after right engine failure
chain.trigger: the accident airplane deviated 55° in a right turn away from the localizer course

caused_by.evidence: The deviation to the right was likely the result of asymmetrical thrust caused by stoppage of the right engine

chain.label: Left engine intermittent power loss from fuel unporting

caused_by.evidence: assuming some usable fuel was in the left tank
conditions would have been conducive to unporting if...the airplane was in a left bank and in a nose-right sideslip following the loss of the right engine

chain.label: Loss of control at low altitude
chain.trigger: Impact witness marks and airplane damage were consistent with a loss of control at low altitude

caused_by.evidence: the final loss of control may have been precipitated by momentary stopping or starting of the left engine when the airplane was at a reduced airspeed

chain.label: Ground impact
chain.trigger: the airplane impacted the ground at a 60° nose low attitude and in a 135° left bank

caused_by.evidence: Ground and tree impact marks indicated that the airplane impacted terrain at a steep angle and in an extreme bank angle

chain.label: Fatalities
chain.trigger: 17 passengers and two flight crewmembers were killed

caused_by.evidence: The accident was not survivable because of high impact forces. Autopsies determined that the passengers and flight crew died of blunt force trauma.
